meaning: The quasar shell as dots: one in 2 of the tracked DESI sample (one in 100 of the catalogue) on DESI's footprint, and one in 2 of Quaia's, at the same density on the sky, everywhere else.

banks.basis: Presentation choice: the two samples together hold 70,423 quasars and a bank draws at most 40,000 (MAX_CATALOGUE_POINTS), so both keep one in 2 and stay at one density.
Presentation choice: the same share as DESI's, so the shell stays even.
